newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end volatile trade slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end volatile trade slightly lower.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed slightly lower on Tuesday after a day of volatile trade.
The Nikkei average's decline, which continued from Monday, induced some buying back in late trade, but the bottom side is likely to be still vulnerable, brokers said.
The key Nikkei 225 average was down 44.13 points, or 0.21 percent, at 20,630.56. Its December futures were 20 points lower at 20,660.
The Nikkei index briefly slipped to 20,478.74 in mid-afternoon, partly due to speculative futures sales and weaker blue-chip issues, they said.
